name: Soft Beef Tacos with Shredded Romaine & Spicy Salsa
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry lettuce, tomatoes, jalapeños, and green onions.
Add beef to the skillet and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until beef is browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Add chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper to skillet and stir to combine with the beef. Remove skillet from heat.
Halve the lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Small dice the tomatoes. Seed and mince the jalapeños. Trim and discard root ends and chop green onions.
In a small bowl, prepare the salsa by mixing together tomatoes, jalapeño, onions, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
To serve, fill tortillas with shredded lettuce, ground beef, and salsa. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
